title: Members per tier
statementMd:
Count members per tier.

Expected columns: `tier`, `members`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT tier, COUNT(*) AS members FROM members GROUP BY tier;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
